import logging
import sys

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
EXIT_FATAL_ERROR = 1


def main():
    try:
        return run_analysis()
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("Unexpected error")
        console.print(f"Internal Error: {e}")
        return EXIT_FATAL_ERROR


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
